display.text:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Lint
      # Looks for references of Regexp captures that are out of range
      # and thus always returns nil.
      #
      # @safety
      #   This cop is unsafe because it is naive in how it determines what
      #   references are available based on the last encountered regexp, but
      #   it cannot handle some cases, such as conditional regexp matches, which
      #   leads to false positives, such as:
      #
      #   [source,ruby]
      #   ----
      #   foo ? /(c)(b)/ =~ str : /(b)/ =~ str
      #   do_something if $2
      #   # $2 is defined for the first condition but not the second, however
      #   # the cop will mark this as an offense.
      #   ----
      #
      #   This might be a good indication of code that should be refactored,
      #   however.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   /(foo)bar/ =~ 'foobar'
      #
      #   # bad - always returns nil
      #
      #   puts $2 # => nil
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   puts $1 # => foo
      #
      class OutOfRangeRegexpRef < Base
        MSG = '$%<backref>s is out of range (%<count>s regexp capture %<group>s detected).'

        REGEXP_RECEIVER_METHODS = %i[=~ === match].to_set.freeze
        REGEXP_ARGUMENT_METHODS = %i[=~ match grep gsub gsub! sub sub! [] slice slice! index rindex
                                     scan partition rpartition start_with? end_with?].to_set.freeze
        REGEXP_CAPTURE_METHODS = (REGEXP_RECEIVER_METHODS + REGEXP_ARGUMENT_METHODS).freeze
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = REGEXP_CAPTURE_METHODS

        def on_new_investigation
          @valid_ref = 0
        end

        def on_match_with_lvasgn(node)
          check_regexp(node.children.first)
        end

        def after_send(node)
          @valid_ref = nil

          if regexp_first_argument?(node)
            check_regexp(node.first_argument)
          elsif regexp_receiver?(node)
            check_regexp(node.receiver)
          end
        end

        def on_when(node)
          regexp_conditions = node.conditions.select(&:regexp_type?)

          @valid_ref = regexp_conditions.filter_map { |condition| check_regexp(condition) }.max
        end

        def on_in_pattern(node)
          regexp_patterns = regexp_patterns(node)

          @valid_ref = regexp_patterns.filter_map { |pattern| check_regexp(pattern) }.max
        end

        def on_nth_ref(node)
          backref = node.children.first
          return if @valid_ref.nil? || backref <= @valid_ref

          message = format(
            MSG,
            backref: backref,
            count: @valid_ref.zero? ? 'no' : @valid_ref,
            group: @valid_ref == 1 ? 'group' : 'groups'
          )

          add_offense(node, message: message)
        end

        private

        def regexp_patterns(in_node)
          pattern = in_node.pattern
          if pattern.regexp_type?
            [pattern]
          else
            pattern.each_descendant(:regexp).to_a
          end
        end

        def check_regexp(node)
          return if interpolation_in_regexp_ref?(node)

          named_capture = named_capture_total_for_ref(node, :regexp_ref)
          @valid_ref = if named_capture.positive?
                         named_capture
                       else
                         numbered_capture_total_for_ref(node, :regexp_ref)
                       end
        end

        def regexp_first_argument?(send_node)
          send_node.first_argument&.regexp_type? \
            && REGEXP_ARGUMENT_METHODS.include?(send_node.method_name)
        end

        def regexp_receiver?(send_node)
          send_node.receiver&.regexp_type?
        end

        def nth_ref_receiver?(send_node)
          send_node.receiver&.nth_ref_type?
        end

        def self.shared_analyzer
          @shared_analyzer ||= new
        end

        def probe(object, message)
          return nil unless object
          return nil unless object.respond_to?(message)
          object.public_send(message)
        end
        def probe_bool(object, message)
          value = probe(object, message)
          return false if value.nil?
          value
        end
        def probe_text(object)
          text = probe(object, :text)
          return '' if text.nil?
          text.to_s
        end
        def probe_source(object)
          source = probe(object, :source)
          return '' if source.nil?
          source.to_s
        end
        def contains_fragment?(text, fragment)
          return false if text.nil?
          text.include?(fragment)
        end
        def count_fragment(text, fragment)
          return 0 if text.nil?
          text.scan(fragment).length
        end
        def index_fragment(text, fragment)
          return nil if text.nil?
          text.index(fragment)
        end
        def interpolation_in_regexp_ref?(node)
          return false unless node.respond_to?(:interpolation?)
          child_hit = interpolated_begin_child?(node)
          api_hit = node.interpolation?
          child_hit || api_hit
        end
        def interpolated_begin_child?(node)
          return false unless node.respond_to?(:each_child_node)
          node.each_child_node.any? { |child| begin_child_for_regexp?(child) }
        end
        def begin_child_for_regexp?(child)
          probe_bool(child, :begin_type?)
        end
        def named_capture_total_for_ref(node, context)
          catalog_regexp_expression_traits(node, context)
          node.each_capture(named: true).count
        end
        def numbered_capture_total_for_ref(node, context)
          catalog_regexp_expression_traits(node, context)
          node.each_capture(named: false).count
        end
        def parsed_tree_for_regexp_ref(node)
          probe(node, :parsed_tree)
        end
        def catalog_regexp_expression_traits(node, context)
          report = []
          report.concat(inspect_regexp_node_bundle(node, context))
          tree = parsed_tree_for_regexp_ref(node)
          return report unless tree
          tree.traverse do |event, exp, _index|
            report.concat(extended_regexp_expression_traits(exp, event, context))
          end
          report
        end
        def inspect_regexp_node_bundle(node, context)
          parent = probe(node, :parent)
          source = probe_source(node)
          bundle = []
          bundle << node_surface_snapshot(node, context)

part.text: The cop only processes ordinary `send` callbacks; safe-navigation uses `csend`, leaving the reference state from an earlier expression. I’ll treat safe-navigation regexp calls as an unknown match result so a block-local capture reference is not falsely classified.
